_comment: Registry of the six content licenses WorshipCommons hosts. song.json "license" must be one of the ids below and the song must live under songs/<lang>/<section>/. tools/validate.mjs enforces that. may / mayNot / must are the church-facing deed shown on the song page; for CC licenses the legal code at legalUrl controls and is never restated. This file is vendored into WorshipCommons/src/licenses.json — keep the two copies byte-identical. Placeholders in "notice": {year} {writer} {version} {licenseUrl} (a song's own licenseUrl, else deedUrl).

licenses.label: Public domain
may: Sing, print, project, record, and stream it
Arrange, transpose, and translate it
Sell your own arrangement or recording
Use it in any media
licenses.notice: Public domain. Free for every use, including commercial.

licenses.label: Free for worship
may: Sing, play, project, and print it in worship
Transpose, arrange, and translate it
Record or stream your service, live or later
Skip a verse or repeat a part
mayNot: Release it as a track, album, or music video
Use it in film, TV, ads, podcasts, or games
licenses.notice: © {year} {writer} · WorshipCommons License v{version} — free for worship everywhere, always. https://worshipcommons.org/license

licenses.label: CC BY
may: Sing, print, project, record, and stream it
Arrange, transpose, and translate it
Sell your own arrangement or recording
Use it in any media
must: Name the license (CC BY, with its version)
Keep a link to the license on every copy you make — slides, charts, streams, zips

licenses.label: CC BY-SA
may: Sing, print, project, record, and stream it
Arrange, transpose, and translate it
Sell your own arrangement or recording
Use it in any media
mayNot: Release a translation or arrangement under a tighter license
must: Name the license (CC BY-SA, with its version)
Keep a link to the license on every copy you make — slides, charts, streams, zips
Share your derivatives (translations, arrangements you distribute) under CC BY-SA too

licenses.label: CC BY-NC
may: Sing, project, print, transpose, arrange, and translate it in a worship gathering that is not sold as a product
Take an ordinary offering during the service
mayNot: Put it on a stream or video that is monetized (YouTube ads, paid download, ticketed live)
Use it in a conference or product people pay to attend as the product
must: Name the license (CC BY-NC, with its version)
Keep a link to the license on every copy you make — slides, charts, streams, zips

licenses.label: CC BY-NC-SA
may: Sing, project, print, transpose, arrange, and translate it in a worship gathering that is not sold as a product
Take an ordinary offering during the service
mayNot: Put it on a stream or video that is monetized (YouTube ads, paid download, ticketed live)
Use it in a conference or product people pay to attend as the product
Release a translation or arrangement under a tighter license
must: Name the license (CC BY-NC-SA, with its version)
Keep a link to the license on every copy you make — slides, charts, streams, zips
Share your derivatives (translations, arrangements you distribute) under CC BY-NC-SA too
